title: Fibre degree bounds multiply under composition (Stacks 03J6)
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If the integer $n$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $f$ and the integer $m$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $g$ [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound], then $nm$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $g\circ f:X\to Z$: for every $z\in Z$ the fibre $X_z=X\times_Z\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(z)$ of $g\circ f$ is finite over $\kappa(z)$ with $\dim_{\kappa(z)}\Gamma(X_z,\mathcal O_{X_z})\le nm$. In particular a composition of morphisms with universally bounded fibres has universally bounded fibres. (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma Tag 03J6.)
